Limb alignment deformities: genu varum and valgumتشوهات محاذاة الطرف: الفحج والروح2

1OSPEMid files · ملفات الميد

Picture: which alignment deformity is shown (normal, varus, knock knees)? Name the one called valgus.

Expected answer · الجواب المتوقع

Genu valgum (knock knees): distal limb angled away from the midline, knees together and ankles apart, Varus (bow legs) is the opposite

الشريان المحيط بالغضروف (Perichondrial artery)

Why · السبب

If the question has "valgus" or "knock knees" -> Genu valgum (knees together, ankles apart).

إذا لقيت "valgus" أو "knock knees" -> Genu valgum (الركب مع بعض والكعبين بعيد).

Your file · ملفك: Mid OSPE compilation (Batch 8)

2OSPEMid files · ملفات الميد

Station 3 (picture): name the lower-limb alignment deformity.

Expected answer · الجواب المتوقع

Genu valgum (knock knees) – distal part angled away from the midline, varus = toward the midline

Bado type II (Monteggia)

Why · السبب

If the question has "alignment deformity" + knock knees, distal part away from midline -> Genu valgum (varus is toward midline).

إذا لقيت "alignment deformity" + knock knees والجزء البعيد مبتعد عن midline -> Genu valgum (الـ varus باتجاه midline).

3OSPEMid files · ملفات الميد

Name this device.

Expected answer · الجواب المتوقع

Skin traction (adhesive/foam straps with weight, maximum about 10 lb), Indication: temporary (preoperative) immobilization of femoral or acetabular fractures, also pediatric femoral fractures/hip pain relief, Complications: skin allergy to adhesive, skin excoriation/maceration and pressure sores, peroneal nerve palsy

Genu valgum (knock knees): الطرف البعيد مائل بعيدًا عن الخط الأوسط، الركبتان متقاربتان والكاحلان متباعدان، و Varus (bow legs) هو العكس

Why · السبب

If the question has no word, the clues: adhesive straps with weight on a leg -> Skin traction.

إذا ما فيه كلمة، الدلائل: adhesive straps مع weight على الرجل -> Skin traction.

Expected answer · الجواب المتوقع

Skeletal traction: pin/wire through bone (proximal tibia, distal femur, calcaneus), Used for femoral/acetabular/pelvic fractures and lower-limb fractures pending fixation, heavy weights possible, Contraindications infection at pin site, osteoporosis, ligamentous injury at the pin site complications: pin-tract infection, vital structure injury, stiffness

الالتواء (Twisting / torsion)

Why · السبب

If the question has "Skeletal traction" + "Steinmann pin" -> pin through bone, heavy weights, femoral or acetabular fractures.

إذا لقيت "Skeletal traction" + "Steinmann pin" -> pin يخترق العظم، weights ثقيلة، لكسور femur وacetabulum.

Quadriceps wasting, loss of knee extension (gives way), weak hip flexion, anteromedial thigh numbness, absent knee jerk.

If the question has "femoral nerve palsy" -> quadriceps wasting, knee gives way, anteromedial thigh numbness, absent knee jerk.

Fracture Types and Open Fractures 1

Gustilo-Anderson Classificationتصنيف غوستيلو أندرسون1

42OSPEMid files · ملفات الميد · Repeated ×2

Station 10: Gustilo-Anderson classification of open fractures.

Expected answer · الجواب المتوقع

I: < 1 cm clean

الصف القريب (Proximal row): scaphoid, lunate, triquetrum, pisiform

Doctor's slide · شريحة الدكتور

Highlighted · المظلل

  • Type I: Skin wound less than 1 cm
  • Type II: Skin wound more than 1 cm
  • Type III: High-energy injury involving extensive soft-tissue damage
  • Type III: Or multifragmentary fracture, segmental fractures, or bone loss irrespective of the size of skin wound
  • Type III: Or severe crush injuries
  • Type III: Or vascular injury requiring repair
  • Type III: Or severe contamination including farmyard injuries
  • Type IIIB: Extensive soft-tissue injury with periosteal stripping and bone exposure
  • Type IIIC: Open fracture with arterial injury requiring repair

اقدر اقفله by primary closure or skin graft

= IIIA: I can close it by primary closure or skin graft (mixed Arabic and English note beside IIIA)

Needs flap

= IIIB needs a flap (English handwritten note beside IIIB)

Communiuted is always 3 / Contaminated always 3

= Comminuted fracture is always type III, contaminated wound is always type III (English handwritten note, spelling as written)

1cm skin injury but on exammination, u cant feel distal pulses ? 3C

= A 1 cm skin wound but no distal pulses on examination is type IIIC (English handwritten note with arrow to IIIC)

Why · السبب

If the question has "Gustilo-Anderson" classification -> Type I: wound under 1 cm, clean.

إذا لقيت "Gustilo-Anderson" -> Type I: جرح أقل من 1 سم ونظيف.

If the question has "under 2.5 years" + spiral tibial fracture with intact fibula -> Toddler's fracture.
